title: 皐月賞の後に・キラキラなんばーわん

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon finishes the Satsuki Sho with a magnificent victory, securing the center spot in the winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Faced with a packed venue of cheering fans, she sees the world through the eyes of a top Umadol for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to see the same sight after a dirt race next. With her objective clearly decided…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon decides to advance on to one of the few classic G1 dirt races—the Japan Dirt Derby.
